notes.title: Small update/Adjustments
notes.notes:
Hi all, This update brings new content, gameplay adjustments, and essential bug fixes. Have fun!

[h3]Content[/h3]
- Added in-game ending event
- Added garage decoration
- Added secret achievement

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Adjusted post-processing (significant update!)
- Adjusted store prices
- Adjusted time intervals between new camera events
- Removed ending text

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed visual arrow issue on the Legal Investment Wizard Bank
- Fixed collider issue allowing the player to walk on furniture
- Fixed issue where the intruder could see the player walking on the street

notes.title: A Purr-fect Update!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce a delightful addition to our game: [b]a new cat feature![/b] Players can now adopt a cat and interact with it in various ways. Get ready to enjoy the company of your new furry friend while exploring new items and achievements!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Adopt Your Feline Friend:[/b] Head over to the store and choose from a variety of adorable cats waiting to find a loving home. Remember to give them plenty of pets and cuddles to build a strong bond!
[*] [b]Nighttime Essentials: [/b]We’ve added two brand-new items to the store that will help you navigate the nighttime with ease. Ensure you and your cat are prepared for anything that comes your way!
[*] [b]Achievements Galore:[/b] Dive into the game and take on 9 new achievements that challenge you to fully embrace the joys of cat ownership. Unlock special rewards as you and your cat survive the night.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievement Unlocking:[/b] Players can now unlock achievements seamlessly. No more missed milestones—celebrate your progress with ease!
[*] [b]Lighting Enhancements:[/b] We’ve resolved various lighting issues to ensure that your game world is as vibrant and immersive as ever.
[*] [b]Miscellaneous Bug Fixes:[/b] Our team has tackled a number of minor bugs to provide a smoother gameplay experience
[/list]
